messages:
sam: Heads up — release v2.18.0 promotion blocked. deploy-bot shows promote job failed for canary. Seeing artifact fetch 404s in the logs.
ci-bot: build #4278 (promote-canary) FAILED · validator-integration · exit 1
ci-bot: ```
ERROR: artifact fetch failed
expected checksum: abc123
actual checksum: --- (not found / 404)
artifact key: models/validator/latest-canary.tar.gz
``` 
elena: looking into logs now. could be remote cache eviction on GCS or a bad artifact key.
priya: re-running the promote job (rerun #4278). will post results. if flaky, we should pin the image digest rather than 'latest-canary'.
ci-bot: rerun triggered: #4278-rerun
liam: if we can't get green within 30m we should hold the change window and avoid the release cut. also need to update release-notes to mention delay.
oncall-rotation: quick grep of failing test stack: `ValidatorService should accept multi-tenant requests` — failure: upstream 502 when fetching model artifact. stack shows `tls: handshake failure` and `reading from gcs: object not found` in alternation.
elena: narrowed it — not TLS. DEPLOY_MODEL_VERSION is empty in the canary Pod. Helm overlay seems to have lost the interpolation after the last chart refactor. that causes the fetcher to request `models/validator/` (no tag) -> 404, checksums mismatch.
priya: that explains the checksum mismatch in the CI log. i'm opening a hotfix PR to set DEPLOY_MODEL_VERSION to v2.17.3 in the canary overlay and add a template rendering unit test.
sam: propose immediate hotfix: pin DEPLOY_MODEL_VERSION to v2.17.3 in canary overlay, promote, then push a proper chart fix in next RC. objections?
liam: no objections. we should also add an entry in the release notes: "canary promotion delayed due to chart env interpolation bug; pinned to v2.17.3 as temporary fix." and include the PR link.
deploy-bot: promotion halted by policy: `canary-promotion-policy` — manual confirm required. to proceed run `/promote canary --force` after human approval.
priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1128 — hotfix + unit test for helm templates. CI running on PR now.
ci-bot: PR CI status: tests running · validator-integration target queued
elena: i manually patched the canary env var in the cluster (short-term) — rerun #4278-r2 passed the integration tests locally (ci-run 4278-r2 green).
sam: excellent. plan: wait for PR CI green + 1 approving review, then schedule promote during next change window (45m). if review stalls, we'll hold the release and update the release notes and status page. assign postmortem after release.
liam: noted. i'll draft the release notes snippet and put a short blurb on the status channel. :thumbsup:
priya: will monitor CI and ping for approvals. thanks.
oncall-rotation: will follow up with a short blameless note and template test follow-up.
sam: closing loop here — thanks everyone. once PR merges, i'll kick the promote in the change window and update the release thread.
